harness_notes: First context preflight used directory disable paths and retained unrelated skills. Documented SKILL.md paths plus isolated seeded-system paths fixed the catalog before inference. Three preflight contexts retained.

First canary shell was rejected under the unconfigured sandbox. MXC compatibility probe succeeded; second canary failed because inherit=none omitted core Windows directories. Third canary with MXC/core environment read exact synthetic sentinel. Earlier failures retained and excluded from domain counts.
An environment preflight list serializer initially treated a string list as a skill-config table list; corrected before that canary model execution.

The preliminary assessment parser dropped digit-containing names and treated a compound command exit as failure to read its first file. Final activation checks require complete normalized SKILL.md bytes in actual tool output, preserving all command exit codes and rg no-match results. No model output changed.

The first generic stock-bot prompt was under-scoped for Alpaca. Its expected field/result are retained; a separate explicit Trading/Alpaca prompt and supplied n8n-flow task were pinned before submission. No feedback given.
A local helper dependency download failed; no system or network settings changed. Hosted Windows/Linux jobs obtained the pinned packages and executed FITS checks.
Provenance editing briefly changed migration line endings; restored original bytes except the intended exporter override hash/reason before final generation/validation.
ChatGPT browser inventory exists but page control timed out. No new home/workout or native ChatGPT host test was submitted.
